troubleshooting_of_engine_system.title: TROUBLESHOOTING OF ENGINE SYSTEM (S MODE)
topics: METHOD OF USING TROUBLESHOOTING CHART
S-1 STARTING PERFORMANCE IS POOR (STARTING ALWAYS TAKES TIME)
S-2 ENGINE DOES NOT START
a) ENGINE TURNS BUT NO EXHAUST SMOKE COMES OUT (FUEL IS NOT BEING INJECTED)
b) EXHAUST SMOKE COMES OUT BUT ENGINE DOES NOT START (FUEL IS BEING INJECTED)
S-3 ENGINE DOES NOT PICK UP SMOOTHLY (FOLLOW-UP IS POOR)
S-4 ENGINE STOPS DURING OPERATIONS
S-5 ENGINE DOES NOT ROTATE SMOOTHLY (HUNTING)
S-6 ENGINE LACKS OUTPUT (OR LACKS POWER)
S-7 EXHAUST SMOKE IS BLACK (INCOMPLETE COMBUSTION)
S-8 OIL CONSUMPTION IS EXCESSIVE (OR EXHAUST SMOKE IS BLUE)
S-9 OIL BECOMES CONTAMINATED QUICKLY
S-10 FUEL CONSUMPTION IS EXCESSIVE
S-11 OIL IS IN COOLING, OR WATER SPURTS BACK, OR COOLANT LEVEL GOES DOWN
S-12 OIL PRESSURE CAUTION LAMP LIGHTS UP (DROP IN OIL PRESSURE)
S-13 OIL LEVEL RISES
S-14 COOLANT TEMPERATURE BECOMES TOO HIGH (OVERHEATING)
S-15 ABNORMAL NOISE IS MADE
S-16 VIBRATION IS EXCESSIVE
